# Subtitle / caption test fixtures

Synthetic MPEG-TS fixtures generated by
`crates/tst-core/tests/tools/gen_subtitle_fixtures.rs`. None of these
contain real caption content; payloads are hand-rolled to spec-match
each codec's segment / data-unit / cue shape so the demuxer can
exercise classification and round-trip exactness.

These fixtures are produced by our own `Muxer` rather than ffmpeg —
ffmpeg's MPEG-TS muxer doesn't carry WebVTT-in-TS or CEA-708
standalone, and its DVB-sub / DVB-teletext paths require real
encoded payloads that aren't necessary for our test goals. The
bootstrap cycle is: muxer must work to emit these files, and the
files then guard against regression in both mux and demux paths.

## Fixtures

| Fixture | Codec | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `dvb_subtitling_eng.ts` | DVB subtitling | Single English subtitling stream, 3 PES |
| `dvb_subtitling_multi_lang.ts` | DVB subtitling | English + Spanish on two PIDs |
| `dvb_teletext_eng.ts` | DVB teletext | Magazine 8 page 88 (subtitle convention), 3 PES |
| `cea708_standalone.ts` | CEA-708 standalone | Round-trip-only (ffprobe doesn't recognize this carriage form) |
| `webvtt_in_ts_simple.ts` | WebVTT-in-TS | Single cue |
| `webvtt_in_ts_multi_cue.ts` | WebVTT-in-TS | 5 cues with stepping PTS |
| `subtitle_with_klv_same_program.ts` | WebVTT-in-TS + KLV | Cascade exercise (video + KLV + subtitle in one program) |
| `webvtt_multi_program_with_klv.ts` | WebVTT-in-TS, KLV | 2 programs (program 1: H.264 + WebVTT, program 2: H.265 + KLV) |
| `non_conformant_subtitle_missing_descriptor.ts` | WebVTT-shaped, declared as MP2 | `treat_as` exercise (see below) |

## Non-conformant fixture

`non_conformant_subtitle_missing_descriptor.ts` is built by routing
WebVTT-shaped bytes through the AUDIO config path with
`AudioCodec::Mp2` (PMT `stream_type` = 0x03). Result: PMT has NO
subtitle descriptor of any kind — the non-conformance is
structural-by-construction (no PMT-byte rewriting needed).

Default demux behavior: classify PID 0x200 as `Audio(Mp2)`, emit
`SamplePayload::Audio` carrying WebVTT bytes. The codec / payload
mismatch is the caller's problem in that path.

With `DemuxerConfig::treat_as.insert(0x200,
StreamKind::Subtitle(WebVttInTs))`: demuxer reroutes PID 0x200 to
the subtitle dispatch path, emits `SamplePayload::Subtitle`, AND
emits `NonConformantIssue::SubtitleMissingDescriptor` because no
recognized subtitle descriptor is present in the PMT. The `treat_as`
test uses exactly this fixture to verify both halves.

## Regeneration

```sh
./regen.sh
```

Wrapper around
`SRT_FORCE_VENDORED=1 cargo run -p tst-core --bin gen-subtitle-fixtures --release -- <this-dir>`.
Idempotent —
running it again produces byte-identical output (the muxer's PSI
cadence + continuity counters are deterministic when no real-time
clock is involved).

## Provenance

Generated by `gen-subtitle-fixtures` (see Regeneration above).
